answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric attestation creates a secure knoll in the digital landscape, turning a barren network into an oasis of authentic actors. By binding AI identity to a unique physiological willow of data, the system forces attackers to procure distinct physical subjects for every fake profile. This imposes a prohibitive marginal cost on identity synthesis, effectively neutralizing Sybil attacks through the high economic barrier of real-world biometric verification.
